# Results Folder

This folder contains Excel output files generated automatically when the analysis scripts are run.

## Files Generated by MNLFA_lavaan.R

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| Step0_DIF_Test.xlsx | Continuous DIF test results (20 items × DR moderator) |
| Step1_CFA_Results.xlsx | CFA fit indices, loadings, reliability, validity |
| Step1b_CMB_CFA_Test.xlsx | CFA-based common method factor test |
| Step6_Bootstrap_Results.xlsx | Bootstrap BCa 95% CIs (2,000 replications) |
| Step8_Inflection_Points.xlsx | Conditional inflection points at Q25/Q50/Q75 DR |
| Step9_Simple_Slopes.xlsx | Simple slopes at ±1SD × DR quartiles |
| Step10a_Robustness_Outlier.xlsx | Outlier-removed robustness check |
| Step10d_Robustness_MM.xlsx | MM-estimator robust regression results |
| ModelA_Linear_Results.xlsx | Model A: linear baseline coefficients |
| ModelB_Quadratic_Results.xlsx | Model B: quadratic main effects coefficients |
| ModelC_Full_Results.xlsx | Model C: full moderated nonlinear coefficients |
| Table3_Fit_Indices.xlsx | Model fit progression summary (Table 3) |
| Table4_Structural_Coefficients.xlsx | Structural coefficients summary (Table 4) |
| Table_Power_Analysis.xlsx | Post-hoc power analysis results |
| Table_Inflection_Raw_Scale.xlsx | Inflection points on raw 1–5 Likert scale |
| Table_Robustness_Summary.xlsx | Robustness checks summary table |

## Files Generated by MNLFA_Supplementary.R

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| Supp_Desc_Items.xlsx | Item-level descriptive statistics |
| Supp_Desc_FactorScores.xlsx | Factor score descriptive statistics |
| Supp_Desc_Combined.xlsx | Combined descriptives and correlations (Table S2) |
| Supp_VIF_ModelC.xlsx | VIF diagnostics for Model C (Table S5) |
| Supp_Harman_CMB.xlsx | Harman's single-factor test (Table S4) |
| Supp_Simple_Slopes_Full.xlsx | Full simple slopes table (Table S6) |
| Supp_FornellLarcker.xlsx | Fornell-Larcker matrix (Table S3) |
| Supp_Robustness_Extended.xlsx | Extended robustness comparison (Table S7) |

## Figures Generated by MNLFA_lavaan.R

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| Fig1_GAM_Nonlinear_Shapes.pdf | GAM smoothers (Figure S1) |
| Fig2_Conditional_AIP_DR.pdf | Conditional AIP–FSP at three DR levels (Figure S2) |
| Fig3_Conditional_PA_DR.pdf | Conditional PA–FSP at three DR levels (Figure S3) |
| Fig4_Overlay_Interactions.pdf | Overlay of moderated nonlinear effects (Figure 1) |
| Fig5_Simple_Slopes_Publication.pdf | Publication-quality simple slopes figure |
